description.zh:
用户ID类型。当AuthType=1或101，此项必填。

- `www.weibo.com`：微博
- `www.openaccount.alios.cn`：AliOS
- `www.amap.com`：高德
- `www.yundevicedemo.aliyun.com`：YUNDEVICE_DEMO
- `anonymous`：匿名
description.en:
The user ID type. This parameter is required when AuthType is set to 1 or 101.

- `www.weibo.com`: Weibo
- `www.openaccount.alios.cn`: AliOS
- `www.amap.com`: AMAP
- `www.yundevicedemo.aliyun.com`: YUNDEVICE_DEMO
- `anonymous`: anonymous.

description.zh: 数据空间划分和鉴权方式。1-基于账号，2-基于设备，101-基于账号和设备。
description.en:
The data space partitioning and authentication method. Valid values:
- 1: account-based
- 2: device-based
- 101: account and device-based.

description.zh:
设备ID类型。取值范围：**uuid**/**sn**/**vin**/**hardware_id**。

> 当AuthType=2或101，此项必填。
description.en:
The device ID type. Valid values: **uuid**, **sn**, **vin**, and **hardware_id**.

> This parameter is required when AuthType is set to 2 or 101.
The unique identifier of the namespace.
The path of the node to modify, such as `/CarService/Window/SunroofSlideCtrl`.
